title: akikaze-mv

tempo.drift: smooth accelerando over the whole song (see bars[].bpm)

octave_check.verdict: ~102 BPM chosen: the 2x candidate (~204) has similar ACF strength (busy 8th-note parts) but kick/snare alternate at the ~102 level (backbeat on 2 & 4); ~51 would put the snare on every beat

beat_tracking.note: beats = onset-snapped (use for hits); beats_smooth = jitter-free spline grid (same indices; use for continuous motion)

downbeat_info.notes: winning phase = argmax of the weighted per-phase means (bass-chroma change 1.0, chroma change 0.5, kick 0.4, -snare/backbeat 0.4) + 0.08 x bass re-entry counts; see per_feature_phase_means. repeat_lags_mod4_zero_fraction near 1 = repeats are whole bars apart (no odd bars).

sections_method: boundaries+labels curated from bar-level novelty (MFCC, chroma, bass in/out, stops) and aligned bar-chroma repetition; validated at run time (boundary_novelty*, repeat_similarity -> confidence)
